Name: Alternate Portraits for Eugene
Author: AirynS
Description:
Alternate portraits and sprites for the main NPC from the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7002]Custom NPC Eugene[/url] by Leroy / irias0701. The original mod is in Korean and an [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9222]English translation of Eugene[/url] has been made by Sapiescent. This mod will not work without either the original or the English version of Eugene because it’s a portrait
replacer, so please download & endorse Leroy’s and Sapiescent’s work.

To install, just unzip and drop the “[CP] Alternate Portraits for Eugene” folder into your Mods folder.

Manifest.Name: Alternate Portraits for Eugene
Manifest.Description: Changes Eugene's portraits to an alternate style by Airyn.
Manifest.Author: Airyn
